faqs.question: Who is PlexWell Naturals EASSiCHEW Kids Multivitamin suitable for?
faqs.answer: EASSiCHEW is a daily multivitamin and mineral supplement formulated for children aged 3 years and onwards. It provides essential vitamins and minerals to complement a child's everyday diet and support healthy growth, development, immunity and general well-being.

faqs.question: How many EASSiCHEW tablets should my child take each day?
faqs.answer: The recommended serving is 1 chewable tablet daily, preferably with or after a meal. The easy-to-chew format is designed to make daily supplementation convenient for children. Do not exceed the recommended daily intake.

faqs.question: What are the main benefits of EASSiCHEW Kids Multivitamin?
faqs.answer: The formula provides key nutrients including Vitamins A, C, D3, E, B-complex vitamins, Folate, Zinc, Iodine and Calcium. These nutrients help support normal immune function, energy metabolism, healthy bones and teeth, cognitive development, and overall growth and well-being as part of a balanced diet.

faqs.question: Does EASSiCHEW contain artificial colors or added sugar?
faqs.answer: The formula provides 0 g total/added sugars per serving and uses natural colors from beet juice powder and turmeric extract. It is sweetened with xylitol, sorbitol and purified stevia leaf extract and comes in child-friendly cherry, orange and grape fruit flavors.

faqs.question: Why does my baby or child need Vitamin D3?
faqs.answer: Vitamin D is important for normal growth and development of bones in children. It also contributes to the normal function of the immune system and helps the body absorb and use calcium and phosphorus effectively.

faqs.question: How much Vitamin D3 does each serving provide?
faqs.answer: A serving of 2 drops provides 10 mcg (400 IU) of Vitamin D3. The concentrated drop format makes it easy to provide Vitamin D3 without giving a large volume of liquid.

faqs.question: How should I give PlexWell Naturals Baby Vitamin D3 Drops?
faqs.answer: The serving size is 2 drops (approximately 0.06 mL). Administer the drops according to the directions on the product label. For infants and young children, consult your pediatrician or healthcare professional regarding individual Vitamin D requirements, particularly if your child is already receiving Vitamin D from other supplements or fortified foods.

faqs.question: What other ingredients are in the Vitamin D3 Drops?
faqs.answer: The formula is intentionally simple. In addition to Vitamin D3, it contains organic fractionated coconut (MCT) oil as the carrier and natural mixed tocopherols as antioxidants to help maintain the freshness and stability of the oil.

faqs.question: What are the main benefits of PlexWell Naturals Vitamin D3 + K2 Gummies?
faqs.answer: This comprehensive formula combines Vitamin D3, Vitamin K2 (MK-7), Calcium and Magnesium to support normal bone health and muscle function. Vitamin D3 also contributes to normal immune system function and supports the normal absorption and utilization of calcium.

faqs.question: Why are Vitamin D3 and Vitamin K2 combined in one gummy?
faqs.answer: Vitamin D3 and K2 provide complementary nutritional support for bone health. Vitamin D3 supports calcium absorption, while Vitamin K contributes to the maintenance of normal bones. The formula uses Menaquinone-7 (MK-7) as its Vitamin K2 source for a convenient daily combination.

faqs.question: What is the purpose of avocado fats in the formula?
faqs.answer: Each serving contains 50 mg of avocado-derived fats. Because Vitamins D3 and K2 are fat-soluble vitamins, including a lipid component provides a convenient formulation approach for delivering these nutrients together in a gummy.

faqs.question: How many gummies should I take each day?
faqs.answer: The serving size is 2 gummies daily, providing 600 IU (15 mcg) Vitamin D3 and 20 mcg Vitamin K2, along with Vitamin C, Calcium, Magnesium and avocado-derived fats. Each bottle contains 60 gummies, providing a 30-day supply. People taking anticoagulant medication such as warfarin should consult their healthcare professional before using a Vitamin K-containing supplement.

ingredients.name: Coagulation factors (bovine) II, VII, IX, and X

features: World's first primary ready-to-use liquid hemostatic agent.
Arrests bleeding in seconds on contact.
Effective in all kinds of surgeries, all ages, and effective even in presence of anticoagulants or factor deficiencies.
For invasive, semi-invasive, and non-invasive surgeries.

faqs.question: What is SeraSeal?
faqs.answer: A one component hemostatic agent designed to arrest all forms of hemorrhages in seconds. It can be used invasively, semi-invasively, and non-invasively.

faqs.question: What is in SeraSeal®?
faqs.answer: SeraSeal® contains bovine proteins: Factors II, VII, IX, and X.

faqs.question: Is SeraSeal® a drug?
faqs.answer: No. SeraSeal® is a Class III Medical Device. The product is applied topically to the wound, and it is not introduced into the vascular system, nor enters the cell, as per the definition of a drug.

faqs.question: Have there been any adverse reactions?
faqs.answer: No. SeraSeal® has had no reported adverse effects. It is estimated that less than 0.05% of the population would be sensitive to SeraSeal®, and they would be patients sensitive to bovine proteins, and a few lupus patients.

faqs.question: Is SeraSeal a bioabsorbable hemostatic agent?
faqs.answer: Yes. SeraSeal has a good bioabsorbtion profile and gets absorbed within 14 days.
